_doc: One entry per sung song, keyed by MUSIC song id. Files live in audio/sing/ as <slug>_backing[ _m].(opus|mp3) + <slug>_<voice>_vox.(opus|mp3) for stems, or <slug>_<voice>.(opus|mp3) for a full mix. 'backing' maps key -> file stem: f = women's key, m = men's key (-12); omit m if one backing fits both. 'stems' and 'mix' list the voices that have each kind; stems win when both exist.
